description: Margin on a load from the buy rate (carrier cost) and sell rate (what the shipper pays): margin in dollars and percent of sell, the per-mile spread when miles are given, and the sell price needed to hit a target margin. Pure arithmetic; does not count toward the allowance.

buy.description: Carrier cost (buy rate) for the load, all-in, in dollars.

sell.description: Shipper price (sell rate) for the load, all-in, in dollars.

target_margin_pct.description: Target margin as a percent of sell, e.g. 15, or null.

name: calculate_margin
title: Calculate freight margin
